$doc: A ratchet, not a snapshot. Every raw colour literal still left in frontend/src outside tokens.css is counted here, per file. The count may only go DOWN: exceed a file's budget and the test fails as a regression; drop below it and the test fails too, telling you the new number to write. Delete the entry when a file reaches zero. When `files` is empty the app has zero raw colour outside the token layer — that is Intent #1 of the aesthetic-overhaul epic (pd-1658) and the terminal state this file exists to reach.
$workflow: Migrating a file: replace its literals with semantic --color-* roles, re-run `npm test` in frontend/, and write the number the failure prints. Do not raise a budget. If a change genuinely needs a new literal, it needs a new semantic role in tokens.css instead.
$scope: Counted in .svelte/.ts/.js/.css/.svg/.html under frontend/src, excluding tokens.css itself and excluding comments. `#rgb`/`#rrggbb` in any length, `rgb()`/`rgba()`/`hsl()`/`hsla()`, and CSS named colours (`color: white`) in a painting property. `transparent`, `currentColor` and `inherit` are not paint values and are not counted.
